_comment: The book's classification tree for naming a word's role (Tasheel al-Nahw). A node is a branch of the book: `branch` its Arabic name, `book` its section and page. A branch with `children` has a `split`, the axis (services/syntax/facts.py AXES, each a question with a closed list of answers) its children divide on; each child takes one answer with `is`, or is the one `else`. A leaf has a `role` (in roles.json). Siblings answer the same question once, so they cannot overlap. Walked by services/syntax/walker.py.
